details:
While working with a friend to setup, and secure, their account, I noticed there is only one way to contact users, a single email.

I work in IT, granted rural town IT support and management, and I see multiple clients a year who have lost access to an account, in one form or another, because their recovery options were out of date. Usually clients who use their ISP (usually no longer active after service is cut or just lost access after cutting service (ATT SBCGlobal comes to mind)) or old work's email, and no longer have access. Granted, the latter wouldn't be used for gaming, I've seen a lot that doesn't make security sense, lol. Especially dealing with Free email, regaining a hacked/lost account is nearly impossible.

Having more than one would be greatly beneficial. I know calls/SMS is likely out of the question, having two (doubtful three) email addresses would help a lot of people.

As a techy, I'd use something like a distribution email group, to multiple emails, but the vast majority of users won't know how or have said resources, lol.

It's happened to many. Realize their password is forgotten and doesn't work, do a recovery, and realize their account (any service) points to an email they haven't used in a while, or lost access to said email address.

Many services like Yahoo, will not let you create a same-email account until at least 2 years after the old had been deactivated, that's not including the time it takes for an email account to be flagged as unused for a year or three. Even email account recoveries have the same chance of being out of date too, lol.
title: Dual email recovery
